comparison.objective: Align, push, and quarter-turn a bayonet cap until mechanically locked; candidate adjusts and tests a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed lug-slot alignment, axial spring compression, and rotation under contact to a stop versus recessed hex insertion, captive screw loosening, separate collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and iterative testing.
comparison.success_condition: Cap must be centered, upright, rotated over 80 degrees, retained under the roof, released, and still. Candidate requires a locked setting plus two force-, travel-, rebound-, and drift-safe impact cycles.
comparison.reason: This is the closest lock-by-rotation primitive, but it tests mating and latching a separate cap, not changing a setting, relocking its moved socket, or validating dynamic performance.
